rows.note: For the very-large sense, this is the all-purpose everyday choice.

example.english: This house is really elephantine, and there is still room for a whole family.
example.traditional: 呢間屋真係好大，住一家人都仲有位。

rows.note: Use this before a noun when something resembles an elephant in appearance or a particular feature.

example.english: They have elephantine ears that you can spot from far away.
example.traditional: 佢有對似大象咁樣嘅大耳仔，遠遠都睇得出。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 deoi3 ci5 daai6 zoeng6 gam3 joeng2 ge3 daai6 ji5 zai2 jyun5 jyun5 dou1 tai2 dak1 ceot1

rows.note: Use this before a noun for something belonging to, concerning, or characteristic of elephants rather than merely resembling one.

example.english: This book gives a detailed account of elephantine behavior.
example.traditional: 呢本書講大象嘅生活習性，寫得幾詳細。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 gong2 daai6 zoeng6 ge3 saang1 wut6 zaap6 sing3 se2 dak1 gei2 coeng4 sai3
